entities.name: Zar Ojanen
entities.description: Leonin warrior from Efrava who leads a caravan of Efravan refugees through Jamuraa.

entities.name: Pallar Ojanen
entities.description: Zar's pregnant sister who gives birth to Lark.

entities.name: Lark Ojanen
entities.description: Pallar's newborn daughter and Zar's niece.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: Formidable mercenary from whom Zar is descended.

entities.name: Efrava
entities.description: Once-lush region of Dominaria lost to a catastrophe.

entities.name: Efravan
entities.description: Leonin and mixed humanoid refugees from Efrava.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Healer who interprets dreams and aids the refugees.

entities.name: Denik
entities.description: Niambi's husband who provides safe passage and supplies.

entities.name: Teshunda
entities.description: Magistrate who opposes then grants asylum to the refugees.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: City where the Efravan are granted asylum.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where Zar's caravan travels.

events.summary: The Efravan flee Phyrexian forces; Zar, Pallar and others seek shelter.
events.quote: fled their home to escape the advancing Phyrexian forces.

events.summary: Niambi and Denik aid the refugees despite prejudice from locals and Teshunda's council.
events.quote: Together, they faced prejudice and hostility from the local population and city officials

events.summary: Niambi appeals to Teshunda using a dream of birds tending a sick tree.
events.quote: Niambi appealed to Magistrate Teshunda to reconsider his opposition to the refugees.

events.summary: Pallar gives birth to Lark in the abandoned mine; Teshunda is moved to grant asylum in Femeref.
events.quote: Teshunda was moved to grant asylum to the Efravan in the city of Femeref .
